newsitem.title: JAPAN: RTRS-Nippon Steel to invest in Australian coal mines.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nippon Steel to invest in Australian coal mines.

text.p: Nippon Steel Corp said on Wednesday it plans to acquire stakes in two coal mines in Australia in an effort to secure stable coal supplies.

It will buy a five percent share in the Moranbah-North mine in Queensland from Shell Coal Australia Ltd, and a 6.4 percent stake in the Bayswater mine in New South Wales by early 1997, a Nippon Steel spokesman said.

After the purchase, the Bayswater mine will be owned 78.3 percent by Coal Operations Australia Ltd, 8.7 percent by Nippon Oil Australia Pty Ltd, five percent by Korea Electric Power Corp and 1.6 percent by Nittetsu Shoji Co Ltd, besides Nippon Steel's 6.4 percent, he said.
Nippon Oil Australia is a subsidiary of Japan's leading oil firm Nippon Oil Co Ltd, and Nittetsu Shoji is a trading house affiliated with Nippon Steel.

Output at the Moranbah-North mine, which will start production in 1998, is expected to reach 3.8 million tonnes a year by 2001, while the Bayswater mine's annual production will be expanded to 4.5 million tonnes by 2000 from the current 2.7 million tonnes, he added.
